statements.label: Lemma 1
statements.restatement: For every x in the affine cone over Sec(M), rank Hess C(x) <= 12.

statements.label: Theorem 2
statements.restatement: For every m in X (all finite spectra a, b in C^4, all alpha in C, including degenerate ones), A = Hess C(Re m) has at most 6 positive and 6 negative eigenvalues, generic inertia (6,6,2); every principal 12-minor of A is >= 0, and positive when nonzero; rank 12 implies at least one is positive.

dependencies.ref: HMSV Thm 3.4, Cor 3.9(a), Sect 3.4, Prop 3.19 (dim Sec(M) = 11, polar image dim 9, generic secant point smooth on C)

dependencies.used_for: ker H(m) = tangent space; L cap conj(L) = 0

dependencies.ref: paper Sect. 3 / moc4lib (X in Sing C, dim X = 6, integer parametrization)
